objective: Complete the general resource installation reliability contract: content-addressed immutable artifacts, capacity-aware candidate installation, durable phase recovery, and repair.
boundaries: Local code, focused tests, builds, device installation, and local phase commits only. Do not push or release.
For each phase, validation is limited to one concrete target effect plus one final true-device crash check; no broad suites.
Do not disable concurrency, add resource/device special cases, or restore UI-owned installation state.

lastValidation.name: interrupted root activation restores the durable prior state
lastValidation.summary: The focused recovery test injected process death after candidate root activation but before commit completion; a fresh coordinator restored the prior install root and command, removed owned pending residue, and reported RESTORED. assembleDebug succeeded; Meizu 18 cold start reached MainActivity with process 4590 alive and no AndroidRuntime or ActivityManager error.
